coordinate_observation.basis: In side_negative_y, screen-right is +X. The triangular buttstock is screen-right/raw +X and the two long rail tips are screen-left/raw -X.

two_real_front_muzzles.finding: The actual front at raw -X terminates in two closed blue/white rail caps. No dark open bore, recessed barrel interior, or two distinct muzzle mouths are present.

no_rear_fake_muzzle.finding: The rear buttstock end at raw +X presents two bright cyan hexagonal recessed faces with white collars. They read as a stacked pair of energy muzzles at the stock.

mesh_missing_or_fused.finding: No major missing body section or catastrophic rail/receiver fusion is visible.

hand_contact_possible.finding: A distinct trigger grip and a separate forward underside support handle are physically contactable.

stop_reason: Mandatory muzzle-direction requirements failed. Per assignment, no Blender reconstruction, transform, emission extraction, .blend, or FBX export was attempted.
